title: .jgates/tools.yml
description: Tool instances and their bindings to components.

persona.description: zizmor: how strict the audit is (regular: few false positives; pedantic: code smells too; auditor: false positives accepted).

minSeverity.description: zizmor: the lowest severity that is reported.

offline.description: zizmor: true (the default) never calls the GitHub API; false also runs the audits that need it (a GH_TOKEN is required).

spec.description: oasdiff, schemathesis, zap: the OpenAPI specification, relative to the scan root (oasdiff and schemathesis default: openapi.yaml, openapi.json, swagger.* or the same under api/, docs/, spec/; zap: when set, the API scan replaces the baseline).

target.description: schemathesis, zap: the base URL (http:// or https://, no credentials, query or fragment) of the running local or disposable environment to test. Without it the stage is blocked, never passed.

auth.description: schemathesis, zap: the authentication header sent to the target. The value is read at run time from the environment variable valueEnv; the secret itself is never written here.

seed.description: schemathesis: the random seed of the generated test cases (default 1), so a run can be reproduced.

maxExamples.description: schemathesis: the maximum number of test cases per API operation (default 50).

requestTimeoutSeconds.description: schemathesis: the timeout of each request sent to the target (default 10 s); timeoutSeconds bounds the whole stage.

checks.description: schemathesis: the checks applied to every response (default: not_a_server_error, status_code_conformance, content_type_conformance, response_schema_conformance).

mode.description: zap: passive (default: baseline or API scan with passive rules only) or active (attack payloads; refused unless allowActive is true).

allowActive.description: zap: the explicit permission for mode: active. The plan then lists the effects of the active scan on the target.

image.description: zap: the ZAP image to run (default ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable); it must be present locally, it is never pulled during a run.

blockingRisk.description: zap: the lowest alert risk that blocks (default medium).

spiderMinutes.description: zap: how long the spider of the baseline or full scan may crawl (default 1 minute).

baseRef.description: oasdiff: the git revision (branch, tag, commit) whose copy of the specification is the reference. Without baseRef or baseSpec the stage is blocked.

baseSpec.description: oasdiff: a reference specification file, instead of a git revision.

failOn.description: oasdiff: the lowest level of change that blocks (ERR: breaking; WARN: also potentially breaking).

language.description: codeql: the language of the database the instance creates (required; python, javascript-typescript, java-kotlin, go, csharp, ruby, swift, rust, c-cpp, actions).

suite.description: codeql: the query suite to run (default: security-extended).

buildCommand.description: codeql: the command that builds the project for a compiled language (default: CodeQL's autobuild).

checker.description: build-check: which compiler or type checker the instance runs (tsc, mypy, pyright, go, cargo, dotnet). It checks every unit of its stack that carries the project's configuration for it.

tsconfig.description: build-check (tsc): the tsconfig file to pass to tsc -p, relative to the component (default: tsconfig.json).

rulePack.description: A rule pack shipped with JGates that the instance runs next to its own rules (semgrep: jgates).
